correctness.rationale: Gram entries are exact sinc integrals; characteristic polynomial has p2=(2/3)(3+t²)epsilon²+O(epsilon⁴), determinant=(4/135)(1-t²)²epsilon⁶+O(epsilon⁸). Uniform analytic implicit-function theorem yields smallest eigenvalue epsilon⁴ times 2(1-t²)²/[45(3+t²)]+O(epsilon⁶) in C². Strict gap and local concavity plus evenness prove unique optimizer t=0. Explicit t=0 eigenvalue yields both coefficients; equality M=1 iff all off-diagonal integrals vanish, giving integer-gap classification. Reproducible check.py checks expansions and finite examples; numerics alone do not prove infinite claim.

value.rationale: Stable selection of three closely spaced Fourier atoms with fixed bandwidth is a natural sharp lower-Riesz-bound experiment-design question. The optimizer rigidity is proven rather than imposed by symmetry, the higher-order exact conditioning benchmark is computable, and parity-dependent nonuniform perfect-conditioning resonances show a structurally different regime. Not merely an arbitrary numerical improvement.
